hook.name: RelaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 0.9% (90 bps) ETH fee on every swap in Relaunchpad pools: fee is deducted from ETH input on buys via a beforeSwap delta, and from ETH output on sells via an afterSwap delta, paid directly to each pool's registered fee recipient. Only exact-input swaps are accepted; pool initialization is restricted to the bound factory address.
